integrity: Two exact independently implemented enumerations agree on all rank totals; finite-field lifting certified by a four-root polynomial-degree and coefficient-bound argument. Included source files and output reports permit reproduction.
scientific_limitations: Finite order-ten five-by-five Fourier submatrix rank and incidence only; no generalization to other orders, no stability or singular-value bound; not a new full-spark row classification. Historical-priority uncertainties remain and independent audit has not been performed.
title: The complete five-frequency rank-incidence census for the ten-point Fourier transform
